Headline: CFD Comeback Rewards: Share 24,000 USDT in Tokens and Earn Up to 962 USDT
Prize pool: 24K USDT
Start: 2026-11-26T09:00:00Z · End: 2026-12-10T09:00:00Z
Most one person can get (parsed): 962 USDT
Smallest threshold (parsed): 120000 USD (trade)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Exclusively for returning CFD traders. Register and reach the cumulative trading volume requirement to receive 2 USDT. Keep trading to unlock tiered airdrop rewards totaling up to 960 USDT. Earn up to 962 USDT in spot tokens per user, credited automatically on a first-come, first-served basis.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 26, 2026, 09:00 – December 10, 2026, 09:00 (UTC)
## Eligible Participants
This event is open only to users who have traded CFDs before and made no CFD trades during the 7 consecutive 24-hour periods immediately before the event starts.
## Event 1: Return to CFD Trading and Receive 2 USDT
During the event, eligible users who register and reach at least 120,000 USDx in cumulative CFD trading volume after registration can receive 2 USDT in spot tokens. Rewards are limited to the first 2,000 qualifying users and credited automatically on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last.
## Event 2: Trade to Unlock an Airdrop of Up to 960 USDT
During the event, reach the required cumulative CFD trading volume after registration to unlock the USDT spot token reward for each tier. Each tier has its own task and reward pool. Rewards from different tiers can be combined for a total of up to 960 USDT. The total reward pool is 20,000 USDT. Rewards are credited automatically on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last.
Trading Volume | Reward per User (USDT Spot Tokens) | Available Spots
5,000,000 USDx | 10 USDT | 850 users
30,000,000 USDx | 150 USDT | 50 users
100,000,000 USDx | 800 USDT | 5 users
## Important Notes
Participants must complete identity verification before selecting [Join Now] on the event page to register. Due to local policies and service coverage limits, participation and registration are temporarily unavailable in some regions.
Trading volume = buy volume + sell volume. Only activity after you register counts toward this event.
A "returning CFD trader" is a user who has traded CFDs before and made no CFD trades during the 7 consecutive 24-hour periods immediately before the event starts.
Event rewards are paid in USDT spot tokens and automatically credited to your account after you complete the corresponding tasks. If a reward is not credited, the rewards have either run out or you do not meet the task requirements.
Gate TradFi services may be restricted in certain jurisdictions, and users in some regions may be temporarily unable to use this feature. Trading traditional financial instruments involves market volatility, leverage risk, and liquidity risk. Before enabling TradFi trading, carefully read the Contract for Difference (CFD) Service Agreement, Risk Disclosure Statement, and terms for each asset class.
Users participating in other Gate events of the same type at the same time can receive rewards from only one event.
Gate will review accounts, trading activity, and fund movements during the event. Prohibited conduct includes using multiple accounts to participate repeatedly, impersonating others or submitting false identity verification documents, self-trading or wash trading, recycling onchain funds, coordinating to improperly obtain rewards, repeatedly transferring funds, and any other conduct that undermines the fairness of the event. If a violation is confirmed, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
Market makers, companies, and institutions are not eligible to participate in this event.
If there is any discrepancy between a translated version and the English version, the English version prevails.
Gate reserves the right to make the final interpretation of this event.
Some or all services (including participation in this event, games, or contests) are unavailable to users in the United Kingdom and other restricted regions. For details about restricted regions, please read the User Agreement.
